Sheepshead Bay · Brooklyn

Greene Street - Brooklyn

Greene Street is at 3448 Nostrand Avenue in Sheepshead Bay, near Avenue U and a short walk from the Avenue U B and Q station. It stocks about 340 products from 64 brands and is the smallest of the three licensed dispensaries we track in the neighborhood. The mix is balanced: 98 pre-rolls, 82 flower options, 80 vapes and 66 edibles, with a small eight-item concentrate case.

Ayrloom and STIIIZY lead the brand list at 32 and 31 products, with Off Hours, To The Moon, Fernway and Wyld behind them. The entry price is $6 for Ayrloom's single-serve 2:1 drinks in lemonade, half-and-half, orange creamsicle and black cherry. Sheepshead Bay is unusually well served for southern Brooklyn: Twenty8gramz and Quality Control both list far more product within a mile, so Greene Street is the convenient stop near Avenue U rather than the deepest menu.

Greene Street - Brooklyn FAQ
How does Greene Street compare to Twenty8gramz?

Twenty8gramz lists more than 1,200 products against Greene Street's 340, so it wins on selection. Greene Street is closer to Avenue U and the B and Q, and carries STIIIZY and To The Moon, so it is worth a stop if those brands are what you want.

Does Greene Street sell flower?

Yes, 82 listings, with To The Moon among the growers stocked. Pre-rolls are slightly deeper at 98.

Is there parking?

Sensei does not track parking. Nostrand Avenue near Avenue U has metered street parking, but confirm with the shop. The Avenue U station is a few blocks away if you are coming by subway.
